root.label: Pezeshkian leaves New York after UN General Assembly speech

events.label: Pezeshkian leaves New York after UN General Assembly speech

slots.name: departure date
slots.sentence: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian left New York City the day after he spoke before the U.N. General Assembly last week, but Araghchi stayed behind for indirect talks with the U.S., the AP reported.
